# AWS X-Ray

Store groups and sampling rules as configuration records without telemetry ingestion or trace analysis.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `xray` |
| Signing name | `xray` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2016-04-12` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 12 of 38 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-x-ray) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Configuration records only; no telemetry ingestion, trace segments, trace graphs, service summaries, or analytics engine.
- Sampling targets and sampling statistics are excluded (GetSamplingTargets, GetSamplingStatisticSummaries).
- Encryption configuration and resource policies are excluded (PutEncryptionConfig, PutResourcePolicy).
- The built-in Default sampling rule cannot be deleted; deletion attempts reject with InvalidRequestException.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
